summary: Found one documentation/count mismatch in the public API documentation: it states all functionality is exposed through 7 methods, while the code also exposes requests.options().

findings.title: API docs say all functionality is available through 7 methods, but options() is also public
findings.evidence: docs/api.rst states: "All of Requests' functionality can be accessed by these 7 methods." and lists request, head, get, post, put, patch, and delete. However, src/requests/api.py defines and exports options in addition to those methods, and src/requests/__init__.py imports options into the public requests namespace.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the API documentation to say 8 methods and include options, or reword the sentence so it does not imply an exhaustive count.
findings.verification_notes: Confirmed: docs/api.rst claims "7 methods" listing request/head/get/post/put/patch/delete; src/requests/api.py and __init__.py also export options().
